item.title: Ukrainian Hike to Fockenstein and Geierstein
item.description: Joining a Ukrainian group to Fockenstein, then taking on Geierstein alone. Hike from Bad Wiessee to Lenggries via Zwergelberg (1113 m), Fockenstein (1564 m), Schlagkopf (1330 m), and Geierstein (1491 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: A Handful of Castles
item.description: Visiting cool castles and ruins between Moosburg and Landshut. Hike from Moosburg an der Isar to Landshut via Berghofen, Kronwinkl, Ast, and Tiefenbach.
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Burried in Snow at Kampen
item.description: Doing a cliffside climb of the Kampen ridge after heavy snowfall. Hike from Kreuth Klamm to Lenggries via Brandkopf (1569 m), Spitzkamp (1604 m), Auerkamp (1607 m), and Ochsenkamp (1594 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Retrieving a Hiking Stick at Sonnenberg
item.description: Going back to the place I failed to take back what's mine. Hike from Unterammergau and back via Sonnenberg (1622 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: All Peaks from Bichl to Bad Tölz
item.description: Checking off all easy hikes in the area at once. Hike from Bichl to Bad Tölz via Hollerkopf (932 m), Enzenauer Kopf (1205 m), Fahrtkopf (1203 m), Angerlkopf (1249 m), Stallauer Kopf (1322 m), Stallauer Eck (1213 m), Zwiesel (1348 m), Heigelkopf (1218 m), and Blomberg (1237/1203/1248 m).

item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Zugspitze Reintal Loop in a Day

item.title: TUM Hike Day 2025: Wendelstein

item.title: Blauberge Ridge Loop
item.description: A summer trip along the Germany-Austria border. Hike from Wildbad Kreuth and back via Predigtstuhl (1562 m), Wichtlplatte (1765 m), Blaubergschneid (1787 m), Blaubergkopf (1787 m), Karspitz (1801 m), and Halserspitze (1863 m).

item.title: Breitenstein and Wendelstein During Rainfall
item.description: Despite the rainy weather, we set out to conquer both Breitenstein and Wendelstein and finish off with some Bayrischzell cake. Hike from Hammer/Fischbachau to Bayrischzell via Breitenstein (1622 m), Türkenköpfl (1512 m), and Wendelstein (1838 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: First Buchstein Climb
item.description: My first cliff climbing experience, extended to a full day hike. Hike from Kreuth to Lenggries via Buchstein (1701 m), Roßstein (1698 m), Mariaeck (1469 m), and Seekarkreuz (1601 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.description: Organized group hike for DAAD scholars. Hike from Oberammergau and back via Schartenkopf (1636 m) Laber Hauptgipfel (1686 m).

item.description: Annette organized a group hike with Easter egg hunting for DAAD scholars. Hike from Geitau to Fischbachau via Türkenköpfl (1512 m) and Schweinsberg (1514 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: São Lourenço PR8 Intro
item.description: A great oceanside hike cut short by a plane ride. Hike at Vereda da Ponta de São Lourenço, partial.
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.description: Big waterfall visit going through tunnels and smaller waterfalls on the way with the final section closed off. Hike from Parque das Queimadas to Caldeirão Verde and back.
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Hoher Fricken with Alcoholics
item.description: A goodbye hike for Mikuláš Netík, meeting German housewives downing schnapps at the top. Hike from Farchant to Garmisch-Partenkirchen via Kuhfluchtwasserfall and Hoher Fricken (1940 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Frau Hitt: Push Through or Lose
item.description: A full-day winter hike over the famous Innsbruck ridge. Freezing cold and icy slopes mixed with frogs and goats. Hike from Scharnitz to Innsbruck via Frau Hitt (2270 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Altmühltal: Riedenburg to Kelheim
item.description: A historical walk along river Prunn through Celtic settlements. Hike from Riedenburg to Saal through Prunn, Essing, Kloster Weltenburg, and Kelheim.
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Hochstaufen DAAD Tour
item.description: A DAAD tour I organized as a change of pace from the usual destinations. Hike from Piding to Bad Reichenhall via Fuderheustein (1321 m) and Hochstaufen (1771 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Seekarkreuz DAAD Tour 2025
item.description: Annette organized a DAAD hike to the summit going down to the Hirschbachstüberl restaurant. Hike from Lenggries to Seekarkreuz (1601 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Herrsching to Tutzing
item.description: One morning I was bored and decided to walk from one popular Bavarian lake to another. Hike from Herrsching to Tutzing via Andechs, Erling, Machtlfing, and Traubing.
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Rampoldplatte as a First
item.description: Testing the fitness of a new friend on a moderate winter route. Hike from Brannenburg and back via Rampoldplatte (1422 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.description: A winter rendition of the route I organized for DAAD with the group dwindling down. Hike from Kufstein and back via Petersköpfl (1745 m), Einserkogel (1924 m), Zwölferkogel (1912 m), and Pyramidenspitze (1997 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.description: Crossing the ridge of the highest mountain in the Rosenheim district. Hike from Bayrischzell to Oberaudorf via Großer Traithen (1852 m), Unterbergerjoch (1813 m), Steilnerjoch (1747 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)
